'''Superior Demonbane''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 62 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast. This spell has a base max hit of 23, but can only be cast on [[Demon (attribute)|demonic]] creatures.

By default, demonbane spells have an accuracy bonus of 20%, but can be doubled to 40% when the [[Mark of Darkness]] spell is active, which additionally gives a 25% damage bonus. If attacking with a [[purging staff]], this is further doubled to an 80% accuracy and 50% damage bonus when under the effects of the Mark of Darkness. All of these bonuses are calculated after the player's own [[magic damage]] bonuses from their equipment.
